questions.q: Plaster beads fixed with ≥75 mm steel fixings at ≤450 mm centres?
Riser door perimeter gaps 3 mm (±1 mm), lock/cylinder working?
Air temperature between +5°C and +30°C during boarding and jointing?

notOk.t: Board joints staggered less than 600 mm (123–285 mm recorded on SJWS)
Screws missing the stud / driven too deep
Corner screw centres over 200 mm (up to 290 mm recorded)
Narrow slivers of board at openings (poor setting out)
Tape and jointing missing at low level behind skirting
Damaged board or paper facing peeling left in
Gaps around back boxes in acoustic / fire walls
